gaps.title: Strong-wind nights are not forecast (deterministic NBM POD 0 on 49 observed >= 15 mph night events)
gaps.whyItMatters: Strong-wind nights are where the wind forecast fails and where exposure matters most. Windy-hour error is 1.96 m/s and forecast-vs-observed surface-class agreement at observed >= 10 mph is 0.42; Wind Capability V2 items WI3, WI4 and EA1 hold about 21 of its 33 missing points.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Wind input to Sector Intelligence: whether a calm or moderate wind forecast can be trusted to keep an exposed shoreline's surface undisturbed tonight.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when a method pre-registered before 2027-01-01 has been scored once on H2 (NBM probability recalibration first; RRFS first fair look 2027-01-01, decision-grade 2027-04-01), or when no candidate source remains. Never tune on H2.
gaps.expectedOutput: One sealed-holdout result per pre-registered method with an accept/reject recommendation; if accepted, a versioned strong-wind signal the exposure assessment may use to lower (never raise) confidence.

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: Michael approves any promotion; validation itself is H2-gated, not field-gated.

gaps.title: No real bank has been checked: exposure ordering is unvalidated (0 of 24 required paired site-nights)
gaps.whyItMatters: Shoreline ranking is the product. It runs and is physically coherent on all four lakes, but nobody has confirmed that a bank the model calls sheltered looks calmer on the water. Certification dimension 6 (20 pts) and the Scientific Confidence item bankExposureField depend on it.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Wind input to Sector Intelligence: which shorelines are exposed to or sheltered from a given wind direction.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop at >= 40 eligible blinded holdout pairs on >= 2 lakes and >= 3 wind quadrants (certification floor 24), or when the owner declines the field campaign.
gaps.expectedOutput: A certification run under Evidence Addendum v1: concordance with volume, recorded in the append-only certification ledger.

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: Blinded paired bank observations under the frozen protocol (exemplar photo set first); owner approval of lakes and protocol.

gaps.title: Surface classes are unvalidated at bank scale (0 of 36 required observations; buoy exact-class 0.41)
gaps.whyItMatters: The fishing-impact wording rests on the surface class. Buoys are not banks; certification dimension 7 (20 pts) and the Scientific Confidence item surfaceField depend on bank observations.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Wind input to Sector Intelligence: how much the wind disturbs the surface at a given bank.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop at >= 60 stratified holdout observations (floor 36) or when the owner declines the field campaign.
gaps.expectedOutput: Exact / within-one / severe-miss rates on the field holdout and a recommendation on the class bounds.

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: Observer surface classes 1-5 under the frozen protocol.

gaps.title: No wave memory: modeled chop disappears the moment wind eases (M0); M4 failed its promotion rule
gaps.whyItMatters: After a blow the timeline is optimistic. The exposure assessment flags those hours (recessionOptimistic) but cannot say how long chop lingers. Wind Capability V2 TI3 (6 pts) and part of SI2.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Wind input to Sector Intelligence: how soon wind-driven disturbance at an exposed bank subsides after the wind drops.
currentEvidence: WIND_M4_PREREG (failed rule 1 by 2 points of retention)
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when a new parameter-free memory model is pre-registered and scored once on a fresh buoy holdout plus the fixed SWAN scenarios, or when no unused buoy seasons remain.
gaps.expectedOutput: A promotion decision for one memory model; if promoted, a shadow timeline path behind an explicit model id.

gaps.title: Direction accuracy 0.758 within 22.5 deg (certification full credit at 0.85); scored on all hours for a night product
gaps.whyItMatters: Banks near the edge of shelter swap with small direction errors. No tested source improves it; the night-only metric (0.86-0.90) is a rubric-fit question for review, not something to change here.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Wind input to Sector Intelligence: whether a bank at the edge of a point is in the wind's lee tonight.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when the rubric review decides the night-weighting question or a new source is pre-registered.
gaps.expectedOutput: A recorded rubric-governance decision; no score change without it.

gaps.title: No over-water wind reference (certification cap 7.0)
gaps.whyItMatters: All wind validation is at land stations; over-water wind can be stronger. Not binding until certification exceeds 7.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Wind input to Sector Intelligence: how much stronger the wind is on open water than the airport says.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when one qualifying over-water station record exists or the owner declines the hardware.
gaps.expectedOutput: A land-to-water factor with sample size, and removal of the 7.0 cap.

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: Owner approval of a dock-mounted anemometer (TVA 26a).

gaps.title: Certification block is a frozen 2026-10-13 snapshot; live reliability needs 30 valid days and a refresh run
gaps.whyItMatters: Dimension 8 grows only when a newer block is admitted. The refresh gate (wind_score_refresh.py) exists; it needs a candidate block computed from the cloud archive metadata.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: None directly: operational maturity, not capability.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when a refreshed block is admitted with >= 30 valid days, or when a ledger inconsistency needs a decision.
gaps.expectedOutput: An admitted certification block and its history line.

gaps.whyItMatters: The bank-level wind assessments exist and are tested, but Sector Intelligence cannot use them until an approved activation (storage artifact -> Publisher contract -> Intelligence consumption).
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Wind input to Sector Intelligence's recommendation: which banks are exposed to or sheltered from tonight's wind.
